svg.title: Bachelor thesis, Leiden University (LIACS): Side-channel analysis of the PROACT chip prototype. Captured 160,000 power traces from four cryptographic co-processors on an FPGA: two AES cores, Ascon and Xoodyak. Wrote the capture firmware in C and the analysis pipelines in Python for TVLA, SNR and CPA. Found significant data-dependent leakage in all four co-processors. Recovered the full AES-128 key from both AES cores with first-order CPA.
